title: Jupiter enters Leo
body:
We bring a creative pursuit into the open and invite friends to take part. What felt like a small pleasure can become the plan everyone wants to join before we know whether we can sustain it. As Jupiter enters Leo, we grow through visible self-expression, big-hearted generosity, and the confidence to risk a larger stage. Once praise starts coming, we commit more time, make bolder promises, and give the idea more room.

We feel the pressure when we begin judging the pursuit by the attention it receives. Jupiter expands whatever is already in motion, not only what deserves more room. Creative courage and inflated ego can grow together, until every setback threatens to become a drama. We do not need to shrink desire; we need to keep sharing the joy without making recognition the price of staying involved. Once excitement settles into routine, we find out whether we are building a meaningful practice or only chasing applause.
